# gpupaas_ssh_keys (Data Source)

List the SSH keys of a project, or of one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The SSH keys of one workspace. Without `workspace`, the whole project: its workspaces' keys too, and each
# item says which workspace it lives in.
data "gpupaas_ssh_keys" "team_a" {
  project   = "system-catalog"
  workspace = "team-a"
}

# Read each one back by name for the rest.
data "gpupaas_ssh_key" "each" {
  for_each  = toset(data.gpupaas_ssh_keys.team_a.names)
  project   = "system-catalog"
  workspace = "team-a"
  name      = each.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Project to list.

### Optional

- `workspace` (String) Only the entries of this workspace. Unset lists the whole project, the entries of its workspaces included.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `items` (Attributes List) The SSH keys, sorted by name, with a few identifying fields. Look one up by name for the rest. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `names` (List of String) Names of the SSH keys, sorted.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name.
- `public_key` (String) The OpenSSH public key.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace that owns it; empty for a project-scoped one.
